name: hangcord
description: HangCord — better place to hang out. Monorepo (see docs/MASTER_PLAN.md §13).

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:js && npm run desktop:check
scripts.test: npm run test:js && npm run desktop:test
scripts.checkpoint: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run check:secrets-names && npm run ui-test
scripts.graph:hook: node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('.git'))throw new Error('run git init first');fs.copyFileSync('graphify/hooks/pre-commit','.git/hooks/pre-commit');fs.chmodSync('.git/hooks/pre-commit',0o755);console.log('pre-commit hook installed')"
